The *Oṭṭhanillehaka-sikkhāpada* (Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Sekhiya 54) is a training rule for Buddhist monastics cataloged in the Vinaya Piṭaka, addressing proper etiquette and deportment during meals—specifically regulating against licking one's lips while eating. An English translation of the rule has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali under the title *Licking the lips*.
